GGFS.settings.menu.hint: Choose which users keep the memory of the map they explored.
GGFS.settings.notifyOnShare.name: Announce sharing in chat

GGFS.config.title: GG Fog Scout · Explorers
GGFS.config.hint: Checked users keep what they explored. Unchecked users only see what their tokens can see right now, with no memory of the map.
GGFS.config.note: Unchecking someone does not erase their saved exploration: it is frozen and returns untouched if you check them again.
GGFS.share.title: GG Fog Scout · Share map
GGFS.share.hint: Copy one user's explored fog to the others on this scene. The classic moment: the scout comes back and draws the map for the party.
GGFS.share.warning: This overwrites the recipients' exploration on this scene. It cannot be undone.
GGFS.share.chat: {from} shares the map of what they explored.
GGFS.share.gmOnly: Only the GM can share exploration.
GGFS.share.noTargets: Pick at least one recipient other than the source.
GGFS.share.sceneOff: Fog exploration is disabled on this scene.
GGFS.share.unsupported: This Foundry version does not expose canvas.fog.sync. Sharing is unavailable.
GGFS.share.failed: Could not synchronize exploration. Check the console.
GGFS.warn.notPatched: GG Fog Scout could not hook into the canvas on this Foundry version. Selective exploration is inactive.
